notes:
The dashboard no longer says things it can't know. On a fresh install it showed a local model as the agent's brain before your API key was even saved, and "agent ready" went green before the agent could actually answer. Both now report the real state - "still setting up", "needs a key" - and the model pill tells you which model the provider confirmed generated your last reply.

Claude Opus 5 is now the default for new cloud installs (same price as 4.8, which is still selectable).

Setup now looks like SocialAgent instead of a stock grey wizard.

Uninstall finishes with a tick and one line inst
